_comment: WITHHOLD ESCALATION arm, RE-RUN POST-WIND-UP-FIX (SPEC_withhold_era_release 8.5 step 2).
Knob-verbatim clone of _fld63_relevel4h_wh.json (escalate 12 + free_erase over the ON leg)
with only the product path redirected.  Section 7 measured this arm on a binary that
PREDATES the carrier-phase wind-up sign fix (4f49fa2 + 0d25aa0), which is documented
solve-affecting on field data, so every G3 number is inadmissible under invariant #6.
WHY THIS RUN IS DECISIVE: section 7 refused promotion because settled sigma0 rose to 2.42,
and attributed the rise to the escalation REMOVING the invariant-#1 cliff that had been
amputating stressed carries.  On the current binary THERE IS NO CLIFF: the same ON config
now runs eras of 1/20/7 epochs, the 20-epoch era exits by EMIT at tow 269760 without ever
reaching the 30-epoch (900 s) timer, and the retirement census shows the worst inject-side
stale event is 21 entries across 2 stations -- a station-dropout signature, not a fleet
re-level.  So the attribution's premise is absent, and this run tests it directly.
REFERENCE (same exe, same posture, measured): ON leg = 453 emitted / 28 withheld, eras
1/20/7, settled-tail (tow>=266400) median sigma0_pf_phase = 2.0902 over 213 emitted epochs,
with ZERO vacuous (<0.10) epochs in that tail -- an honest bar, unlike the cliff-flattered
1.274 section 7 graded against.
PRE-REGISTERED: (1) the 20-epoch era collapses (escalate_landed >= 1 inside it) and total
withholds fall below 28.  (2) settled-tail median sigma0_pf_phase vs 2.0902: at or below
=> section 7's quality objection was an artifact of the retired binary and the escalation
is promotable on availability grounds; materially above => the cost is real and INDEPENDENT
of the cliff, which falsifies section 7's own attribution while upholding its verdict.
(3) the stop rule stands: escalate_exhausted ~ era length with no collapse => the
budget-limited model fails on this binary and the residual is common-mode.
